items.title: Bad Wolves Singer Speaks Out After Band Is Dropped From Skillet Tour, Guitarist Quits Over Dolly Parton Cover
items.summary: A lot is going on with Bad Wolves. The Los Angeles metal band lost its vocalist last year when D.L. Laskiewicz departed to play in Falling In Reverse. Sara "Killboy" Skinner was announced as the new singer two months ago, and now Bad Wolves have been removed from an upcoming tour with Christian rock group Skillet, allegedly due to Skillet fans’ complaints about Skinner’s involvement. The post Bad Wolves Singer Speaks Out After Band Is Dropped From Skillet Tour, Guitarist Quits Over Dolly Parton Cover appeared first on Stereogum .
